name: Seared Ribeye & Roasted Thai Green Curry Veggies with Sesame Seeds
ingredients: ¼ cup Thai curry paste, green
instructions: Place curry paste, water, oil, sesame seeds, and spices in a large bowl. Stir to combine the marinade.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; large dice. Add to the bowl with the marinade along with the broccoli and mushrooms; stir to coat.

Transfer veggies to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and veggies between plates; sprinkle veggies with more sesame seeds. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
